# Media library (community, Node only)

A `mediaItem` entity that **extends** `file`: every file field, plus `alt`, `decorative`, `credit` and `license`, stored in a site store. When the files plugin saves an image, `file.after.save` adds a library record waiting for alt text (`mediaLibraryList?missingAlt=1`).

Hooks on a parent entity also see entities that extend it. A mediaItem save fires `file.after.save` too, so the hook checks `ctx.entityType` and acts only on real files. Alt text cannot be blanked unless the image is marked decorative.

<!-- implements:start (generated by scripts/plugin-docs.mjs from plugin.yaml and the docblocks in the code; do not edit by hand) -->
## What it implements

| Kind | Name | Runs when | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|---|
| hook | `file.after.save` | the file is stored | Gives each newly uploaded image a library record with empty alt text, credit and license. |
| hook | `entity.before.update` | an entity is about to be updated | Refuses an update that clears an image's existing alt text unless the image is marked decorative. |
| operation | `mediaLibraryList` | `GET /x/api/v1/plugins/<id>/items` (bearerAuth) | Lists the library's images; with ?missingAlt, only those that still need alt text and are not marked decorative. |
| operation | `mediaLibraryDescribe` | `PUT /x/api/v1/plugins/<id>/items/{uuid}` (bearerAuth) | Updates an image's alt text, decorative flag, credit or license. |

Each code row matches a docblock (`Implements hook ...`, `Implements operation ...`) directly above the implementation in `src/nodejs`.
